thread:
incident-bot: Pager: network-high-severity -> oncall_net (priority: P1)

oncall_net: saw alerts for high packet loss on transit uplink to carrier-omega in eu-west-2, paging now.

sam.nguyen: Confirmed. TCP retransmits spiking to 35% from ~00:12 UTC.

alex.tan: traceroute to affected prefix shows timeout at carrier-omega peering hop.

maria.kapoor: Customer-facing impact — a subset of API requests to eu-west are timing out or getting 5xx, current error budget unclear. @support-lead can you pull recent SLOs?

support-lead: Pulling SLO dashboard now. Seeing 99.6% for eu-west 99th latency and 0.8% 5xx in past 15m. Will assemble impacted customer list.

oncall_net: Initial mitigation plan: 1) divert new traffic from carrier-omega to backup transit (carrier-zeta) via BGP community tagging; 2) enable more aggressive ECMP across regional peers; 3) if flap persists, shift affected prefixes to upstream-mpls link.

sam.nguyen: Working on announcing community to prefer carrier-zeta. Pushing route-map change on edge routers now.

alex.tan: FYI I see intermittent BGP UPDATE storms from carrier-omega every ~2m, routes withdrawing/announcing. Might be their internal flap.

maria.kapoor: @oncall_net start running impact queries: auth, embeddings, stream endpoints. Add "impact": true flag to logs query to speed it up.

oncall_net: Executed route-map update. Announced local pref to prefer carrier-zeta for prefixes: 203.0.113.0/22, 198.51.100.0/24.

gw-monitor-bot: Automated check: traffic shift to carrier-zeta observed, packet loss dropped from 28% -> 6% within 45s for pinned prefixes.

sam.nguyen: Good. Now watching for connection draining effects and application retries.

support-lead: Noted some customers still see errors — likely sessions pinned to established TCP with carrier-omega. Will send customer advisory draft in #customer-success after we stabilize.

alex.tan: Running `show ip bgp neighbors` on edge1: neighbor 10.10.10.2 (carrier-omega) flapping, 10% peer resets in last 10m.

```
show ip bgp neighbors 10.10.10.2
  BGP state = Established, up for 00:06:12
  Last reset 00:05:47, 60 notifications sent
  Update source 10.0.0.2
  12 prefixes received, 4 withdrawn in last 2m
```

maria.kapoor: Estimate of customer impact: 12 customers with traffic primarily in eu-west region may see degraded performance; 3 customers on Dedicated networks likely affected. Escalating to Account Execs for those 3.

oncall_net: Timebox mitigation: if flaps continue for >20m revert route-map and prep for provider contact & ticket.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2001501234; severity: S1; lead: oncall_net; channel: #incidents.

sam.nguyen: Paging carrier-omega NOC now (ticket submitted #CO-2001). Sharing BGP logs and sample pcap.

alex.tan: Also opened TAC with cloud provider to see if there's any ECMP churn on our fabric causing multiple equal-cost paths to oscillate.

support-lead: Draft advisory ready. Summary: "We are aware of degraded connectivity affecting a subset of EU requests due to an upstream provider network instability. We are actively rerouting traffic and monitoring recovery. No data loss expected." Will post once oncall confirms stability.

maria.kapoor: @sam.nguyen can you run a targeted test suite against eu-west endpoints (auth, sync, stream) and paste failures? Need concrete numbers for postmortem.

sam.nguyen: Running now. Quick snapshot: auth failures from eu-west at 00:18-00:22 UTC peaked ~2.4% failing, currently 0.3% after traffic shift.

gw-monitor-bot: Synthetic check: eu-west token generation latency p50=120ms p95=520ms p99=1500ms during flap. Now p95 ~260ms.

oncall_net: Ok holding. If carrier-omega stabilizes we'll keep normal routing; otherwise plan B is to shift via upstream-mpls at 00:45 UTC.

alex.tan: Carrier-omega responded: investigating internal router causing route flap; requesting we keep sessions for now to aid their debugging. They asked to stop aggressive withdraws.

maria.kapoor: Decide to keep the route preferences (carrier-zeta preferred) but avoid withdrawing routes entirely to prevent reconvergence storms. Maintain announced prefixes to both to keep sessions alive.

support-lead: Posting advisory to status page now. Draft pinned in #customer-success for review. :loudspeaker:

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: oncall_net to hand to next-night-shift at 2001503000 UTC.

oncall_net: Handoff ack. I'll prepare brief: what happened, prefixes affected, mitigation steps taken, tickets opened (CO-2001), current status (holding, residual 1-2% 5xx).

sam.nguyen: Final check: packet loss on carrier-omega still shows small spikes ~3-5% but stable on carrier-zeta. Recommend follow-up: request formal RFO from carrier-omega, monitor BGP UPDATE rates for 24h, add community-based dampening if repeated.

maria.kapoor: Agreed. Post-incident actions: customer outreach for impacted accounts, update runbook with forced traffic-shift steps, and add automated health-based route failover to reduce manual steps.

support-lead: I'll notify AE and Customer Success teams, include timeline and mitigations.

oncall_net: Closing on-call actions. Leaving incident open until carrier-omega confirms fix. Handoff to next oncall in channel.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: monitoring -> investigating -> mitigated (partial).

alex.tan: Logging the BGP show outputs and route-map commits to the incident ticket.

maria.kapoor: Thanks team. Keeping this thread open for postmortem notes.

support-lead: will file customer follow-up email template once we have RFO. :+1:
